tasks.title: Project Setup and Core Infrastructure
tasks.description: Initialize the TypeScript project with proper tooling, dependencies, and project structure
tasks.details: Create a new Node.js TypeScript project with ESM modules. Install dependencies: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, undici, vitest, eslint, typescript-eslint. Set up tsconfig.json with strict mode and ESM target. Create the directory structure: src/, src/auth/, src/http/, src/domains/, src/middleware/, src/transport/. Configure package.json with proper scripts for build, test, lint, and CLI entry point. Set up ESLint configuration with TypeScript rules.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify project builds successfully with tsc, passes linting with eslint, and all dependencies resolve correctly. Test that the CLI entry point can be executed.

subtasks.title: Initialize npm project and install dependencies
subtasks.description: Create new Node.js TypeScript project with ESM modules and install all required dependencies.
subtasks.details: Run `npm init -y`, set 'type': 'module' in package.json, install @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, undici (prod), vitest, eslint, @typescript-eslint/parser, @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin (dev). Verify installation with npm ls.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check package.json has correct 'type' field and all dependencies listed. Run `npm install` to verify no errors.

subtasks.title: Configure tsconfig.json with ESM and strict mode
subtasks.description: Set up TypeScript compiler options for ESM modules, strict type checking, and Node.js 20 compatibility.
subtasks.details: Create tsconfig.json extending @tsconfig/node20/tsconfig.json and @tsconfig/strictest/tsconfig.json. Set module: 'NodeNext', moduleResolution: 'NodeNext', outDir: 'dist', rootDir: 'src', target: 'ES2022'. Include src/ directory.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` to verify configuration is valid without compilation errors.

subtasks.title: Set up ESLint with TypeScript rules and package.json scripts
subtasks.description: Configure ESLint for TypeScript/ESM and add npm scripts for build, test, lint, and CLI execution.
subtasks.details: Run `npx eslint --init` choosing TypeScript, ESM, Node env. Install typescript-eslint plugins if needed. Add scripts to package.json: 'build': 'tsc', 'test': 'vitest', 'lint': 'eslint . --ext .ts', 'dev': 'tsx watch src/index.ts', 'start': 'node dist/index.js'.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run all npm scripts (build, test, lint) to ensure they execute without errors on empty project.

subtasks.title: Create directory structure and basic CLI entry point
subtasks.description: Establish project folder structure and create minimal CLI entry point file.
subtasks.details: Create directories: src/, src/auth/, src/http/, src/domains/, src/middleware/, src/transport/. Add src/index.ts with basic CLI: import config from './config.js', log 'MCP Server starting...', handle process signals for graceful shutdown. Ensure .js extensions in imports.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run `npm run build` to compile without errors, then `npm start` to verify CLI entry point executes and handles shutdown signals.

tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down into: 1) Initialize npm project and install dependencies, 2) Configure tsconfig.json with ESM and strict mode, 3) Set up ESLint with TypeScript rules and package.json scripts, 4) Create directory structure and basic CLI entry point.

tasks.title: Configuration Management System
tasks.description: Implement environment variable-based configuration with validation and defaults
tasks.details: Create src/config.ts that reads and validates all required environment variables: TDX_BASE_URL, TDX_BEID, TDX_WEB_SERVICES_KEY, and optional variables like TDX_TICKETING_APP_ID, TDX_MCP_TRANSPORT, etc. Implement validation for required fields, URL format validation, GUID format validation for BEID/WebServicesKey. Provide sensible defaults for optional fields. Export a typed configuration object that other modules can import.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for configuration validation with valid/invalid environment variables. Test default value assignment and error handling for missing required variables.

subtasks.title: Implement Environment Variable Reading with Type Definitions
subtasks.description: Create TypeScript type definitions for all configuration variables and implement reading from process.env in src/config.ts with sensible defaults for optional fields.
subtasks.details: Define an interface for the Config type including required fields (TDX_BASE_URL, TDX_BEID, TDX_WEB_SERVICES_KEY) and optional ones (TDX_TICKETING_APP_ID, TDX_MCP_TRANSPORT). Use process.env to read values, provide defaults like 'stdio' for TDX_MCP_TRANSPORT, and export a typed config object. Create environment.d.ts for type safety.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests to verify type definitions compile without errors and default values are correctly assigned when env vars are absent.

subtasks.title: Add Comprehensive Validation Logic for URLs, GUIDs, and Error Handling
subtasks.description: Implement validation functions for required fields, URL format for TDX_BASE_URL, GUID format for TDX_BEID and TDX_WEB_SERVICES_KEY, with proper error messages and process exit on failure.
subtasks.details: Use regex for GUID validation (e.g., /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i) and URL validation via new URL() try-catch. Validate required fields are non-empty. Throw descriptive errors and use process.exit(1) if invalid. Integrate into config loading.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for valid/invalid URLs and GUIDs, missing required vars causing exit, and error messages matching expected formats.

tasks.expansionPrompt: Divide into: 1) Implement environment variable reading with type definitions, 2) Add comprehensive validation logic for URLs, GUIDs, and defaults with error handling.

tasks.title: TeamDynamix Authentication and Token Management
tasks.description: Implement JWT token lifecycle management with automatic refresh
tasks.details: Create src/auth/token-manager.ts implementing the TokenManager class. Use POST /api/auth/loginadmin with BEID and WebServicesKey to obtain JWT tokens. Decode JWT to extract exp claim for expiry tracking. Implement automatic refresh 1 hour before expiry (23-hour refresh cycle). Handle 401 responses by immediately re-authenticating and retrying once. Store tokens only in memory, never persist to disk. Provide methods: getValidToken(), forceRefresh(), isAuthenticated().
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests with mocked HTTP responses for successful login, token refresh, and 401 handling. Integration tests against real TDX API if sandbox available. Test token expiry calculation and refresh timing.

subtasks.title: Implement JWT Login and Token Storage/Decoding
subtasks.description: Create TokenManager class constructor and login method to authenticate via POST /api/auth/loginadmin using BEID and WebServicesKey from config, decode JWT to extract exp claim, and store tokens securely in memory.
subtasks.details: Use undici for HTTP POST request. Implement JWT decoding without verification (client-side) using base64 parsing to extract payload and parse exp timestamp. Store access_token and expiry in private class properties. Handle login errors and initial authentication.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test successful login with mocked HTTP response containing valid JWT, verify token decoding extracts correct exp, test invalid credentials error handling.

subtasks.title: Implement Automatic Refresh Logic and Expiry Tracking
subtasks.description: Add logic to track token expiry from decoded exp claim, schedule automatic refresh 1 hour before expiry (23-hour cycle), implement getValidToken(), forceRefresh(), and isAuthenticated() methods.
subtasks.details: Use setTimeout or similar for scheduling refresh based on calculated refresh time (exp - 1 hour). Implement forceRefresh() to call login endpoint and update stored tokens. getValidToken() checks current time vs expiry and refreshes if needed. isAuthenticated() checks if valid token exists.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for expiry calculation, mock Date.now() to test refresh timing, test forceRefresh() updates tokens, verify getValidToken() returns fresh token when expired.

subtasks.title: Implement 401 Error Handling and Retry Mechanism
subtasks.description: Add interceptor logic to detect 401 responses from API calls, trigger immediate re-authentication via forceRefresh(), retry the original request once, and integrate with public API methods.
subtasks.details: Create private _makeAuthenticatedRequest() method that wraps HTTP calls, catches 401, calls forceRefresh(), retries once. Ensure all token-requiring operations use this method. Memory-only storage enforced - no localStorage or file writes. Export public methods from class.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests with mocked HTTP client returning 401, verify auto-refresh and single retry succeeds, test double 401 failure handling, integration test full auth-refresh-retry cycle.

tasks.expansionPrompt: Split into: 1) JWT login and token storage/decoding, 2) Automatic refresh logic with expiry tracking, 3) 401 error handling and retry mechanism with public API methods.

tasks.title: HTTP Client with Rate Limiting
tasks.description: Build HTTP client wrapper with TeamDynamix rate limit handling
tasks.details: Create src/http/client.ts and src/middleware/rate-limiter.ts. Implement HTTP client using undici that automatically adds JWT bearer tokens. Parse X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset headers from all responses. Track rate limit state per-endpoint. Queue requests when rate limit is exhausted, calculating wait time from X-RateLimit-Reset header. Implement exponential backoff with jitter for 429 responses. Enforce minimum 5-second wait floor per TDX documentation.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for rate limit header parsing, queue management, and backoff logic. Mock HTTP responses with various rate limit scenarios. Test concurrent request handling and proper queuing behavior.

subtasks.title: HTTP Client Wrapper with Token Injection
subtasks.description: Implement base HTTP client in src/http/client.ts using undici with automatic JWT bearer token injection from TokenManager.
subtasks.details: Create undici request wrapper that fetches valid token via TokenManager.getValidToken(), adds Authorization: Bearer header. Handle basic request/response flow with TypeScript types.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test token injection on requests, mock TokenManager, verify Authorization header presence and correct token value.

subtasks.title: Rate Limit Header Parsing and State Tracking
subtasks.description: Parse X-RateLimit-Limit, Remaining, Reset headers from responses and track per-endpoint rate limit state.
subtasks.details: Create RateLimitState interface with limit, remaining, reset timestamp. Implement per-endpoint Map storage in rate-limiter.ts. Update state from every response headers.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests parsing various header combinations, state updates, endpoint-specific tracking with mocked responses.

subtasks.title: Request Queuing System Implementation
subtasks.description: Build queue system that holds requests when rate limit exhausted, calculates wait time from X-RateLimit-Reset.
subtasks.details: Implement per-endpoint request queues using arrays/PriorityQueue. Check remaining limit before dispatch, queue if 0. Use setTimeout with reset time calculation and 5s minimum floor.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test queueing when remaining=0, proper wait time calculation (current time to reset + 5s floor), sequential dequeuing.

subtasks.title: Exponential Backoff with Jitter for 429 Responses
subtasks.description: Handle 429 Too Many Requests with exponential backoff (base 1s, max 60s) plus full jitter implementation.
subtasks.details: On 429 status, calculate retryAfter = min(60s, base * 2^attempts * (0.5 + 0.5*random)). Integrate with existing queuing. Track per-endpoint attempt counters.
subtasks.testStrategy: Mock 429 responses, verify increasing wait times with jitter variance, reset counters on success, max cap enforcement.

subtasks.title: Concurrent Request Handling and Integration Testing
subtasks.description: Ensure proper concurrent request coordination, integrate all components, add comprehensive testing scenarios.
subtasks.details: Test multiple simultaneous requests to same/different endpoints. Verify no race conditions in state/queueing. Add Vitest tests for all scenarios including edge cases.
subtasks.testStrategy: Concurrent test suites with 10+ simultaneous requests, verify correct queuing/backoff/ordering, coverage >90% for rate limiter module.

tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down into: 1) HTTP client wrapper with token injection, 2) Rate limit header parsing and per-endpoint state tracking, 3) Request queuing system, 4) Exponential backoff with jitter, 5) Concurrent request handling and testing scenarios.

subtasks.details: CLI wrapper: shebang #!/usr/bin/env node, import config.ts for env vars, parse args for transport. Workflow: Use setup-node action, npm install, build, npm publish with GITHUB_TOKEN. Test with npx @chattstate/teamdynamix-mcp-server --help and npm i -g.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run npx and global install tests locally. Trigger workflow on test tag, verify package publishes to GitHub Packages. Check CLI handles missing env vars gracefully and selects transports correctly.

tasks.expansionPrompt: Divide into: 1) package.json configuration for GitHub Packages and bin CLI setup, 2) GitHub Actions workflow for npm publishing and npx/global install testing.

tasks.title: Comprehensive Testing Suite and CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Implement complete test suite and GitHub Actions workflows for CI/CD
tasks.details: Create comprehensive unit test suite using Vitest covering all domains, authentication, rate limiting, and MCP protocol handling. Implement integration tests for real TDX API (gated behind environment variable). Create MCP protocol tests for tool listing, registration, and notifications. Set up GitHub Actions workflows: ci.yml (build, test, lint on push/PR), release.yml (build and publish on semver tags), nightly.yml (edge builds). Ensure >80% code coverage. Add proper error handling and logging throughout the application.
tasks.testStrategy: Achieve >80% code coverage with unit tests. Integration tests should cover full authentication and API call lifecycle. CI pipeline should catch linting, type, and test failures. Release pipeline should successfully publish both Docker image and npm package.

subtasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Unit Test Suite with Vitest
subtasks.description: Create unit tests covering all domains, authentication, rate limiting, and MCP protocol handling using Vitest.
subtasks.details: Write tests in src/__tests__/ following Vitest best practices: use describe/it blocks, mock dependencies minimally, test behavior not implementation, aim for isolated fast tests. Cover auth flows, rate limiter logic, domain handlers from tasks 8-9.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run vitest --coverage, verify >60% initial coverage across all modules, no test flakiness, all assertions pass.

subtasks.title: Develop Integration Tests for Real TDX API
subtasks.description: Implement integration tests that call real TDX API endpoints, gated behind environment variable.
subtasks.details: Create tests/__integration__/tdx-api.test.ts using real config from task 2. Test full auth + API lifecycle for key endpoints (search, create, update). Use process.env.USE_REAL_API flag to skip in CI. Mock only external non-TDX dependencies.
subtasks.testStrategy: Manual run with real creds verifies API responses match expected schemas; CI skips unless flagged.

subtasks.title: Create MCP Protocol Tests for Tool Listing and Registration
subtasks.description: Write tests for MCP protocol handling including tool listing, registration, and notifications.
subtasks.details: Test src/mcp/ handlers: tool listing (all domains), server registration, notification flows. Mock transport layer, verify protocol compliance per @modelcontextprotocol/sdk. Include edge cases like malformed requests.
subtasks.testStrategy: End-to-end MCP flow simulation; validate JSON schemas, error responses, and transport interactions.

subtasks.title: Set Up GitHub Actions CI/CD Workflows
subtasks.description: Create ci.yml, release.yml, and nightly.yml workflows for build/test/lint/publish.
subtasks.details: ci.yml: build/test/lint on push/PR; release.yml: build/publish Docker/npm on semver tags; nightly.yml: edge builds with latest deps. Use matrix for Node versions, cache deps, upload coverage artifacts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Trigger workflows manually/PR, verify green pipelines, successful publishes to registries.

subtasks.title: Ensure >80% Coverage and Add Error Handling/Logging
subtasks.description: Achieve >80% code coverage target and implement proper error handling/logging throughout.
subtasks.details: Run vitest --coverage, iteratively add tests for gaps. Add structured logging (pino?) and error boundaries in auth/domains/mcp. Update config validation from task 2. Enforce coverage threshold in package.json.
subtasks.testStrategy: Coverage report shows >80% lines/branches; integration tests catch unhandled errors; logs contain structured error context.

tasks.expansionPrompt: Split into: 1) Unit test suite for all components, 2) Integration tests with real API, 3) MCP protocol tests, 4) GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows (ci/release/nightly), 5) Coverage reporting and error handling.
